newsitem.title: FRANCE: Adjani to head jury at 50th Cannes festival in '97.
newsitem.headline: Adjani to head jury at 50th Cannes festival in '97.

text.p: French actress Isabelle Adjani will head the jury for the 50th annual Cannes Film Festival next May, festival organisers said on Thursday.

This year U.S. director Francis Ford Coppola presided over the jury of the most highly respected international film competition. The golden anniversary festival is scheduled for May 8-17, 1997, in the Riviera resort town.
The jury selects winners for a variety of film prizes including best film, direction and screenplay. A Cannes award is generally a big box office draw.
Adjani won French film-goers' hearts by portraying tormented women who some critics have said are similar to herself.
She became a superstar at 19 as the love-obsessed daughter of Victor Hugo in Francois Truffaut's "The Story of Adele H.", a role which brought her several international awards.
In 1984, she won Cannes' Best Actress award for her role as a troubled village vamp obsessed by the desire to avenge the rape of her mother in "Deadly Summer".
